checks.detail: Source is imported and locally verified.
Set VISUALGUARD_AWS_OWNER_AUTHORIZED=true only in an owner-authorized runtime.
AWS_REGION and VISUALGUARD_AWS_APPROVED_REGION must be the same valid region.
VISUALGUARD_AWS_ACCOUNT_ID must name the authorized account.
Runtime role ARN is missing, invalid, or belongs to another account.
Choose one explicit target: apprunner, ecs-fargate, or lambda-container.
Cost scope must be existing-budget, free-tier, or zero-new-cost.
VISUALGUARD_ARTIFACT_SHA256 must bind deployment to immutable bytes.
